# [R1026 L] QUICK RACE -> AUTO-GENERATED TRACK (slot 60) -> OK -> race.
# Opens on slot 0. LEFT from slot 0 wraps to the top of the cycler: the
# GEOSPATIAL entry (61) is the first stop, the AUTO-GENERATED one (60) the
# second. Direction row is hidden on a generated slot, so TRACK -> RACE OPTIONS
# -> STUDIO chip (row 6) -> OK is three DOWNs.
sync menu
240 log QR_SLOT0
+30 key down press
+60 key left press
+120 log QR_ON_GEO
+60 key left press
+120 log QR_ON_AUTO
+30 key down press
+30 key down press
+30 key down press
+60 log QR_ON_OK
+30 key enter press
+3000 log AFTER_RACE_START
+300 quit
